job.prompt: Vertical 9:16 cover. In the upper-middle part: small spaced gold capitals «НОВОЛУНИЕ · СЕРИЯ 1», then huge cream bold italic serif «Представь:», then a giant gold bold italic serif «ты — Скорпион», a thin gold line with a small star under it, and a small gold zodiac Scorpio glyph. Below the title: the faceless hero in a black sweater holds a big magnifying glass in front of a detective cork board with red threads and photos (no readable text), squinting suspiciously; the faceless partner peeks from behind, shocked, hands on head; a dark new moon in the starry window. Keep all text between 20% and 60% of the image height; characters fully visible below the title.
